account.label: Account
account.quotaUsed: {{used}} of {{limit}} cloud requests used this period.
account.signedOutHint: Sign in to unlock cloud models and premium features. Everything else keeps working exactly as it does today, signed out.

userName.label: Your name
userName.hint: OpenPal uses it to greet you when you start a new chat. Leave it empty for a generic greeting.

personality.label: Personality
personality.hint: How should your assistant behave? Written as instructions it reads before every chat.

showThinking.label: Show model thinking
showThinking.hint: Some models reason step by step before answering. Show that thinking as a collapsible note above each reply. Turning it off hides it from new replies right away, and stops the model thinking entirely the next time your model loads, so replies come a little faster.

generationStats.label: Show generation stats
generationStats.hint: Show each reply's speed (tokens per second) and how long it took (thinking and the answer combined) in small text beneath it.

autoUnload.label: Smart model loading
autoUnload.hint: While you're typing, your AI stays loaded (or starts loading if it's asleep) so it's ready sooner. Once it's sat idle a while with nothing to do, it unloads automatically to free up memory. You'll get a heads-up first, and you can cancel it.

autoLoadStartup.label: Load model on startup
autoLoadStartup.hint: Load an AI model automatically when OpenPal opens (your last-used model, or the fixed default below) so it's ready before you start typing. Turn this off to open to an idle chat instead.

defaultModel.label: Default model at startup
defaultModel.hint: Which model OpenPal loads when you open it. Using a different model elsewhere (Library, the model switcher) only changes your session. It won't change this.
defaultModel.noModels: Install a model to choose a startup default.

voice.title: Read-aloud voice
voice.subtitle: How the Voice add-on sounds when it reads replies aloud.
voice.notReadyHint: Turn on Voice in Add-ons to hear it.
voice.pickerHint: Pick a voice, or download another language or style.
voice.missingNotice: Your selected voice isn’t installed anymore. Pick one below.
voice.sampleText: Hi there! This is how I'll sound when I read your messages aloud.

agentMode.hint: Let your assistant run shell commands, run code, and read or write files. Everything stays sandboxed to one folder you choose, with your approval for every action.
agentMode.unavailableOnMobile: Agent tools aren't available on mobile yet.

grants.label: Standing permissions
grants.hint: Actions you've told your assistant to always allow. Revoke any of these to require your approval again.

triage.hint: Quietly classifies what you're asking (writing, coding, math, …) to keep reply settings suited to it. Change a slider yourself anytime to override. Nothing here shows up in the chat itself.

safetyDetection.hint: After each reply, quietly checks your message for signs of self-harm or a severe crisis, and if it finds any, shows a banner in the chat with ways to get help. Checked locally, on your Mac; turn it off here if you'd rather not see it.

parentalControls.hint: Set daily limits on when and how much OpenPal can be used for new messages. Past conversations always stay readable. Only sending something new is paused.
parentalControls.noLimits: No limits are switched on yet.
parentalControls.limitUsage_one: Up to {{count}} minute of use a day.
parentalControls.limitUsage_other: Up to {{count}} minutes of use a day.
parentalControls.enterPin: Enter your PIN to change these settings
parentalControls.wrongPin: That PIN isn't right. Try again.
parentalControls.needsLimit: Switch on at least one limit above.

schedule.label: Only allow chatting at certain times
schedule.hint: An end time earlier than the start covers the night: 20:00 to 07:00 allows evenings and early mornings, and blocks the day.

usage.label: Limit time spent here each day
usage.hint: Once the day's time is used up, sending pauses until tomorrow.

message.label: Limit messages sent each day
message.hint: Once the day's messages are used up, sending pauses until tomorrow.

pin.createHint: You'll need this PIN to change or switch off parental controls later.
pin.changeHint: Choosing a new PIN replaces your current one.
pin.newPinSet: New PIN set. Save to apply it.
pin.lockedFor: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.

customModels.label: Add your own models
customModels.hint: Shows a way to add models beyond our picks, from a Hugging Face link or a .gguf file on your computer, at the bottom of the Models page. Models you've already added stay available either way.

logLevel.label: Detail level
logLevel.hint: How much OpenPal writes to its log. More detail helps when something goes wrong and you want to share what happened. Takes effect the next time you open OpenPal.

forceCpu.label: Run on CPU only
forceCpu.hint: Skip the graphics card and run the model on your processor. Try this if the app crashes or stalls when a reply starts, since some GPU drivers are unreliable. It's usually slower, and takes effect the next time your model loads.

diskOffload.label: Run huge models from disk
diskOffload.hint: Let AI models too big to fit in memory run anyway, reading straight from your storage instead. It works for some models, but answers can take several minutes, so only turn this on if you don't mind the wait.

autoUnloadDiskSlow.label: Also auto-unload disk-streamed models
autoUnloadDiskSlow.hint: Off by default: a model running from disk barely uses your graphics memory already, and reloading it can take several minutes, which is usually not worth it just to unload. Turn this on if you'd rather have the memory back.

updates.label: OpenPal updates
updates.hint: OpenPal {{version}}. When on, OpenPal briefly contacts github.com after each launch to check for a newer version. No other data is sent. Off by default.
updates.unavailableOnMobile: Updates for this app come through the Play Store.

engineUpdates.label: AI engine updates
engineUpdates.hint: The AI engine (llama.cpp) ships more often than OpenPal itself, and updating it can add support for new models. When on, OpenPal briefly contacts github.com after each launch to check for a newer build. No other data is sent. Off by default.
engineUpdates.installed: Installed. Restart the AI to use it.

dataDir.label: Where your data lives
dataDir.hint: The folder holding your chats, models, and settings.
dataDir.portableHint: This is a portable copy, so everything stays in this folder.

exportData.label: Export your data
exportData.hint: Save a .zip of everything stored on this device (chats, projects, and files the AI created) as plain files you can open without OpenPal.
exportData.doneWithSkipped: Exported {{conversations}} chat(s), {{projects}} project(s), and {{artifacts}} file(s), but {{skipped}} file(s) couldn't be included.

importData.label: Import from another device
importData.hint: Choose a .zip exported from OpenPal on another device (or an earlier export on this one) to bring its chats, projects, and files here.
importData.doneWithSkipped: Imported {{conversations}} chat(s), {{projects}} project(s), and {{artifacts}} file(s), but {{skipped}} file(s) couldn't be included.

logs.label: Latest logs
logs.hint: The most recent lines OpenPal recorded. Anything sensitive is hidden automatically.

join.hint: Already created a sync group on another device? Join it from here.

dataSync.label: Sync conversations
dataSync.hint: Keep your conversations up to date across every device you've paired above.

relayUrl.label: Sync server (optional)
relayUrl.placeholder: Leave blank to use the default server
relayUrl.hint: Only change this if you're running your own sync server. Most people can leave it blank.

experimental.hint: Unlocks features and plugins that are still being tested. They may change, break, or be removed.

generation.title: Generation
generation.hint: How your AI picks its next words for this chat. The defaults match llama.cpp’s own. Only change these if you know what they do.
generation.cloudContextHint: Context length isn't shown here because it's a fixed, shared setting on the cloud model.
generation.autoSuggested: Auto-suggested defaults for {{model}}. Feel free to adjust. Your changes are saved with this chat.

contextLength.label: Context length
contextLength.hint: How much of this conversation your AI can hold in memory at once. Bigger uses more RAM. Changing this reloads the AI, which takes a moment, and if you shrink it, the AI may lose track of earlier parts of this chat.
contextLength.restartHint: Won’t apply until your model restarts.

chatToolbar.cloudNoParamsHint: This model hasn’t declared which generation settings it supports yet, so none are shown to avoid sending one it would reject.

temperature.label: Creativity (temperature)
temperature.hint: Left: focused and precise. Right: playful and imaginative.

topP.label: Nucleus sampling (Top P)
topP.hint: Only consider the smallest group of likely next words whose odds add up to this share. Lower narrows the choices; 1.0 turns it off.

topK.label: Top K
topK.hint: Only consider this many of the most-likely next words. 0 turns it off.

minP.label: Min P
minP.hint: Drop words much less likely than the top pick. 0 turns it off.

repeatPenalty.label: Repeat penalty
repeatPenalty.hint: Discourage repeating the same words. 1.0 turns it off.

repeatLastN.label: Repeat penalty window
repeatLastN.hint: How many recent words the repeat penalty looks back over. 0 turns it off.

presencePenalty.label: Presence penalty
presencePenalty.hint: Push the model to bring up new topics instead of sticking to ones already mentioned.

frequencyPenalty.label: Frequency penalty
frequencyPenalty.hint: Push the model away from words it's already used a lot in this reply.

maxTokens.label: Max response length
maxTokens.hint: Caps how many words (tokens) a reply can be. Longer replies use more memory and take longer.

seed.label: Seed
seed.hint: Fix this to get the same answer for the same question every time (useful for testing).

fitInfo.label: What do the fit icons mean?
fitInfo.heading: Will it run on this Mac?
fitInfo.perfect: Fits with memory to spare. The lightning marks the fastest picks.
fitInfo.good: Fits in your memory and runs well.
fitInfo.tight: Fits, but only just. Your other apps will feel it.
fitInfo.diskSlow: Doesn't fit in your memory. It can still be used, reading from your disk as it answers, but that is far slower.
fitInfo.tooBig: Needs more memory than this Mac has.

quantInfo.label: What is a quantization?
quantInfo.heading: Quantizations
quantInfo.body: The same model, compressed by different amounts, a bit like saving a photo at a smaller file size. A smaller one uses less memory and answers faster; a larger one keeps a little more of the model's quality.
quantInfo.naming: The names are just labels for how hard it was compressed: Q4 is squeezed more than Q8. If you're unsure, pick the one that fits your Mac best.

library.pickerEmpty: None of our picks fit this Mac yet. Browse Hugging Face in Discover, or turn on “Add your own models” in Settings → AI model.

diskSlowConfirm.blocked: Your disk is too slow for this to be usable. This only works well on a fast internal drive.
diskSlowConfirm.fasterAlternative: Want quick answers instead? {{name}} runs at full speed on this machine.
